description: Use the owner-authenticated My Apps onion-import form for private key files; MCP refuses onion_import key material in tool arguments. Enter new build-secret values through the owner-authenticated My Apps build-credential form; MCP refuses raw new secret values. These legacy schema fields document the underlying operation, not permission to send secrets through MCP. Save an immutable reviewed deployment configuration from a retained-upload plan option. Uses real deployment validation without creating an app, queue job or DNS record. Freezes source/build/server/runtime settings and encrypts environment values; summaries return variable names only. At most 20 pending records, expiring no later than the source plan (24 hours maximum). Review the returned configuration and configuration_digest, then call impreza_apply_project_deployment. Does not reserve domains, ports or capacity. Requires deploy scope and account credentials without resource restrictions.

build_secrets.description: Build-only secrets, encrypted at rest; 256 KiB total. Names are ASCII letters/digits/underscore, starting with a letter. Requires agent build-secrets-v1. npmrc is install-only; other names mount during npm build scripts. Dockerfile builds declare their own mounts. Build output is withheld; use trusted source. Never automatically inherited by previews.

cpus.description: CPU limit (cores; 1.0 = one core). Default 1.0 server-side.

domain.description: Hostname to use, or omit to propose a managed subdomain. No DNS record is created until apply. Omit with onion=true for onion-only.

healthcheck_path.description: node_npm, python_pip or php_composer only. Optional HTTP path such as /health (200 ASCII characters max). Checks 127.0.0.1 on target_port and requires 2xx without redirects. Omit for /: Python/PHP require 2xx; legacy Node accepts status below 500. Saved at creation; previews and redeploys retain it. A failed replacement recovers a verified healthy previous release; first installs keep the agent startup warning policy.

memory_mb.description: Memory limit in MB. Default 512 server-side.

onion.description: Also publish a Tor v3 hidden service. Default false.

onion_import.description: Provide BOTH C Tor key files, base64-encoded: hs_ed25519_secret_key (96 bytes) and hs_ed25519_public_key (64 bytes). One does not replace the other. Requires onion:true and preserves the existing onion address. Deploy-time only; impreza_add_onion does not import identities.

onion_profile.description: Requires onion:true. Standard uses intro-point rate limiting; hardened adds tighter limits and max streams; max adds experimental proof-of-work. Default standard. No DDoS guarantee; max is refused when the host's Tor lacks the PoW module.

plan_id.description: Saved plan ID belonging to this account.

require_healthy_start.description: node_npm, python_pip or php_composer only. Require an explicit healthcheck_path to become healthy before deployment succeeds, including the first install. Requires agent 0.6.3+. Failed first installs remove containers and preserve volumes; eligible previous releases recover. Omit or false keeps legacy behavior. Saved at creation and inherited by previews/redeploys.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Required healthy start only: 30-600 second startup observation budget, default 60; build/recovery time is separate.

target_port.description: HTTP port. Omit to use the selected saved option; review the returned effective target_port.

tor_egress.description: Opt-in Tor-only runtime egress for custom image/source builds. Requires SOCKS5 remote-DNS support and tor-egress-v1 agent capability. Direct runtime/DNS egress fails closed. Source fetch/build is not routed through Tor. No imported Compose or external service bindings.

vars.description: Runtime environment values, encrypted in the prepared record. Do not use reserved system/routing names. Summaries show names only.

volumes.description: Absolute container paths to persist as named Docker volumes (data survives redeploys), e.g. ["/var/lib/app/data","/app/uploads"].

name: impreza_prepare_project_deployment
title: Prepare reviewed deployment
